greeting: The calendar's nearly empty today, Dan — one birthday reminder and nothing else booked. A clean stretch to knock down the overdue few that keep rolling forward.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week was due to book Sept 14 and is the hardest holiday rental in that market. A refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule and pack the passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: The four girls' passport appointment needed rescheduling after the Sept 20 return, and the DS-11 packet still needs one printer sitting before anyone goes to the counter.

needsAttention.title: Call the dermatologist for Mike
needsAttention.detail: The wart-removal booking call has sat since late August; new-patient derm waits run weeks, so the booking date is the part that matters, not the procedure date.
